purpose: Does the fast windowed PBT still match or beat the best fixed learning rate with a second training seed? Validation-selected checkpoints of the fast PBT and of a fixed-LR grid around the train800k optimum (6e-5-1.6e-4), both trained with seed 22345, on the frozen Stage 2A holdout. The seed-12345 checkpoints of the same comparison are re-evaluated as references. Primary comparison: fast PBT against the fixed-LR grid, seed 22345.
